tournament.name: TNBBL Season 2 (Tamil Nadu Battleground Bidding League)
tournament.description: Tamil Nadu Battleground Bidding League Season 2. 36 Premier District Franchise Teams competing across Group A, Group B, and Group C with 216 drafted esports athletes.
tournament.rules:
1. 36 Franchise Teams distributed across Group A, Group B, and Group C.
2. Max Squad Size: 6 Members per team.
3. Base Bid Price: ₹5,000 per card.
4. Ambassador Purse: ₹1,50,000 per team.
5. Purse Gatekeeper: Bidders must always maintain enough purse budget for all remaining squad slots.
